title: metrology-atlas: a machine-readable metrology of a recorded dataset
description: A machine-readable metrology of a recorded dataset: every variable as a distribution over its true time and value, with the clocks, models and studies behind it; compiled to one JSON file and a website. Includes the VitalDB atlas as its first dataset.

creators.name: Goodwin, Andrew J.
creators.affiliation: School of Biomedical Engineering, The University of Sydney
